description: This file contains utility functions for handling NGAP ASN.1 messages, including extracting cause strings, message types, and UE IDs (RAN and AMF) from various NGAP message structures. It references multiple NGAP-related external files and types, and defines functions within the ocudu::ocucp::asn1_utils namespace.

methods.name: get_cause_str
methods.description: Returns a string description of the cause based on its type, or 'unknown' if unrecognized.

methods.name: get_message_type_str
methods.description: Returns a string representing the NGAP PDU message type; calls report_fatal_error on invalid type.

methods.name: get_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Extracts the RAN UE ID from various NGAP message structures, returning std::optional<ran_ue_id_t>.

methods.name: get_amf_ue_id
methods.description: Extracts the AMF UE ID from various NGAP message structures, returning std::optional<amf_ue_id_t>.
